portrait.alt: The photographer in a dark suit with hair tied back, on a phone call, standing among broad garden leaves at dusk with warm lights in the background.

series.name: Structural Tension
series.thesis: Load, axis, repetition. The engineering was always visible. Most people look at the decoration.

series.name: Altitude
series.thesis: Systems with no operator. Rock, fog and water at scales the body cannot estimate.

series.name: Signal / Noise
series.thesis: Streets run at a terrible signal-to-noise ratio. The frame is the filter.

series.name: Chiaroscuro
series.thesis: Light as a scarce resource. Whatever it does not reach is allowed to underflow to black.

photos.title: Moment Arm
photos.alt: Black and white view straight up a tapering concrete tower that leans and flares against a blank sky, a dark vertical channel running up its spine.

photos.title: Recursion
photos.alt: Looking up an orange steel spiral staircase coiling through a raw concrete shaft, its metal handrails tightening toward the centre.

photos.title: Axial Load
photos.alt: Black and white view straight up the central staircase of a stepped stone pyramid, its terraces cutting horizontal bands across the frame.

photos.title: Split Horizon
photos.alt: A curving urban highway seen from height, split down the middle by the edge of a glass facade that mirrors the road and sky back on itself.

photos.title: Occlusion
photos.alt: Black and white. A snow-dusted mountain ridge surfacing through thick cloud above a dark line of conifers.

photos.title: Observer
photos.alt: A hooded figure seen from behind standing on a boulder, looking across a grey volcanic valley ringed by rock walls under flat cloud.

photos.title: Snow Line
photos.alt: A wall of snow-streaked peaks above a turquoise glacial lake, framed by dark conifers and an overhanging branch.

photos.title: Deprecated Path
photos.alt: Worn stone steps climbing into a dark forest, broad leaves growing over them in the foreground and a thin gap of pale sky far above.

photos.title: Line Noise
photos.alt: Power lines slashing diagonally across a red and grey storm sky, above the silhouette of rooftops and a dark ridge.

photos.title: Outlier
photos.alt: A figure in a horned goat mask and shaggy costume with a painted ribcage, gripping a staff topped with skeletal hands, against a pale sky.

photos.title: Signal Floor
photos.alt: A narrow commercial street crowded with vertical Japanese signboards and paper lanterns, with an ornate street lamp at the centre.

photos.title: Integration Time
photos.alt: Long exposure of a lit brick building at night, traffic reduced to pale horizontal streaks and a thin red line of light running across the facade.

photos.title: Underside
photos.alt: Night view beneath an elevated concrete structure, columns and a steel footbridge receding along a paved walkway to a small lit street stall.

photos.title: Night Shift
photos.alt: A person carrying a large black bag walks past a shuttered yellow and white colonial facade at night, lit from above by lamps under dark awnings.

photos.title: Transmission
photos.alt: A rose window of stained glass photographed at a steep angle, its colours glowing out of complete darkness.

photos.title: Bound
photos.alt: Black and white portrait of a bearded person in a knit cap, arms crossed over the chest, one hand wrapped in cloth, looking away.

photos.title: Two in the Array
photos.alt: Black and white. A long wall of glowing glass panels divided by dark steel ribs, with a couple on a bench silhouetted behind a railing.
